2_2_1.label: Global Analytics Patches & Feature Expansion
2_2_1.h1: Secured data integrity globally by permanently fixing Activity Tracker KP drops and missing Dead Troop summaries
2_2_1.h2: Overhauled the Discord Server commands route handling to properly mount the /bind Farm Siphoning mechanics
2_2_1.c1: Global Analytics (Delta Engine) — Repaired structural mapping bug where calculating dead troop deltas strictly resolved to zero.
2_2_1.c2: Activity Tracker Data Normalization — Resolved a case-sensitivity parsing drop from AWS DynamoDB to properly extract kill points.
2_2_1.c3: Discord Bot Data Retrieval — Corrected an outdated timestamp mapping pattern that inadvertently blocked /jarvis and /stats API queries.
2_2_1.c4: Activity Tracker Wildcards — Upgraded the tracker's dashboard API to permit unbounded cross-kingdom trajectory retrieval.
2_2_1.c5: AWS DynamoDB Retroactive Injection — Executed a master system patch to backfill historically missing 'Deads' metrics directly into the chronological data pools.
2_2_1.c6: Discord Slash Commands — Overhauled the native Discord /help UI embed and fully mounted the Farm Authentication bindings logic.

2_2_0.label: Advanced Data Sandbox & Cloud Forensics
2_2_0.h1: Engineered a robust Data Sandbox for real-time dynamic mapping of legacy Excel files to native JSON parameters
2_2_0.h2: Built end-to-end data audit tracking, permanently linking uploaded Source Files directly into the AWS DynamoDB Global Matrix
2_2_0.c1: Sandbox Raw Data Inspector — Admins can dynamically map unrecognizable legacy Excel headers into strict Unity variable structures
2_2_0.c2: Explicit DTG Master Control — HTML5 Datetime-local inputs integrated to manually inject exact historical Scan Date times
2_2_0.c3: Global Cloud Audit Log Expansion — A new Source Origin column natively tracks and renders the actual Excel file names used to trigger Cloud uploads
2_2_0.c4: Origin File Signatures — All Sandbox cloud ingestions are permanently branded with their forensic Filename directly inside the DynamoDB DATES partition key
2_2_0.c5: Excel Target Interception — The Sandbox matrix bypasses generic Sheet Names to extract root Kingdom IDs directly from the OS Filename

2_1_0.label: Event & Presence Matrix
2_1_0.h1: Deployed the Global Event Trajectory AWS engine, securely bridging Web UI and Discord cron jobs
2_1_0.h2: Built the Governor Presence tracking architecture for live status webhook routing
2_1_0.c1: Global Event Trajectory UI — Web Admins can now map out Competitive schedules natively
2_1_0.c2: Governor Presence Modal — Players can sync Working/Sleeping/Vacation schedules directly to AWS
2_1_0.c3: Discord Webhook Router — Event cron jobs aggressively ping target channels precisely 15m and 0m before events
2_1_0.c4: /event schedule (Discord) — Implemented native Timezone Offset logic to eliminate UTC paradoxes
2_1_0.c5: /config channel (Discord) — Administrators can designate exact channels for Pipeline routing
2_1_0.c6: Repaired the /bind Discord module and flushed the missing Slash Command arrays into production

2_0_0.label: The V2 Platform Rewrite
2_0_0.h1: Full platform rebuild on Next.js + AWS DynamoDB — zero legacy dependencies
2_0_0.h2: Discord OAuth authentication replacing manual token flows
2_0_0.h3: All pages now server-side rendered with isolated API routes (no exposed secrets)
2_0_0.h4: Recharts data visualizations across Kingdom, Global, Pre-KvK and DKP dashboards
2_0_0.c1: Kingdom Vault — Leader-only RSS economic reserve tracker
2_0_0.c2: Pre-KvK Rankings — Algorithmic Preparedness Score leaderboard with podium
2_0_0.c3: DKP Results Board — Post-KvK Tier grading system (S+ through F)
2_0_0.c4: KvK After-Action Report — Alliance Hegemony output and Top 10 Vanguard Warriors
2_0_0.c5: Kingdom Analysis (Area Charts) — Chronological Power trajectory visualization
2_0_0.c6: All Kingdom Stats (Bar Charts) — Multi-KD comparative Power and KP metrics
2_0_0.c7: My Alliance Hub — Dynamic roster filtered by Alliance Tag via AWS query
2_0_0.c8: Activity Tracker — Chronological delta comparison (NEW / MISSING / GROWTH)
2_0_0.c9: Player Hunter — Cross-Kingdom search via DynamoDB GOV_PROFILE index
2_0_0.c10: Mail Generator — KvK Push, Rally, and General message templates
2_0_0.c11: Calculators — RSS estimation and Speedup math tools
2_0_0.c12: Admin Panel — AWS Cloud Control, Tenant Management, Upload Triggers
2_0_0.c13: Replaced monolithic 4,716-line index.html with modular Next.js pages
2_0_0.c14: Replaced 4,711-line render-blocking style.css with Tailwind CSS
2_0_0.c15: Eliminated 3× exposed credential vulnerabilities from public stages
2_0_0.c16: Migrated from self-hosted MySQL to serverless AWS DynamoDB
2_0_0.c17: All secrets now strictly server-side via .env.local — never bundled to client
2_0_0.c18: Role-based access control on all leader routes (isLeader + Admin gates)
